title: Innovate Iloilo Recognized as a Key Innovation Partner by UMWAD Western Visayas
excerpt: As Iloilo continues to emerge as a dynamic hub in the Philippines, its economic landscape reflects...
body: Innovate Iloilo has been recognized with a prestigious plaque of recognition and a certificate of appreciation as “Innovation Partner” by UMWAD Western Visayas during the 1st Innovative Startup Fest Conference. This honor serves as a testament to the strides Innovate Iloilo has made in fostering innovation and propelling the startup ecosystem in Region 6.

The award acknowledges our organization's substantial contributions to the development of the regional startup scene. Through active participation in key projects, strategic partnerships with local and international stakeholders, and the implementation of forward-thinking programs, Innovate Iloilo has continuously championed the growth of Iloilo’s innovation landscape.

At the core of this recognition is our commitment to nurturing a vibrant, inclusive, and dynamic startup community. From empowering emerging businesses with the necessary tools to thrive in today’s competitive market to hosting collaborative events that bring together entrepreneurs, industry leaders, and innovators, we have remained a driving force in making Iloilo a premier innovation hub.

In particular, our involvement in initiatives such as the Innovate Iloilo Roadmap, which aims to make Iloilo the leading innovation hub by 2030, has significantly contributed to the advancement of key sectors in the region. The recognition by UMWAD Western Visayas underscores the importance of these efforts and serves as an inspiration for continued work in fostering innovation across the province and beyond.

This recognition not only highlights the past and present achievements of Innovate Iloilo but also motivates us to continue pushing boundaries, collaborating with key industry players, and creating more opportunities for startups and businesses in Region 6.

We are grateful to UMWAD Western Visayas for this honor and look forward to further strengthening our partnership as we continue to build a thriving ecosystem that supports innovation, entrepreneurship, and sustainable economic growth in the region.
